Phase.107 §11.37 — motion-gate per-camera confidence thresholds. Per-class values OVERRIDE the per-class defaults in infra/motion_gate_pipeline.py (THRESHOLDS_BY_CLASS). Per-camera values OVERRIDE per-class for that camera+class. Format: {'<camera_name>': {'<coco_class>': <threshold>, ...}, ...}. Thresholds are 0.0-1.0 confidence. Lower = more permissive (more passes to Qwen). Higher = more strict (more suppressions). Tunable after week 1 of production data.
Phase.152: each camera may have a top-level "gate_enabled" field shaped like {"vehicle": bool, "person": bool, "animal": bool, "motion": bool}. Default if missing: all True. See infra.is_gate_enabled() and PLAN §11.75.

Phase.154 (§11.77): each camera may have a top-level "gate_cooldown" field shaped like {"vehicle": int_seconds, "person": int_seconds, "animal": int_seconds, "motion": int_seconds, "default": int_seconds}. 0 or absent = no cooldown (backward-compatible). Applied at the gate BEFORE motion gate runs. See infra/gate_cooldown.py.

Phase.167 §13.4 Commit 17 (T3 C17): top-level keys are CAM{N} codes per infra.cameras._LEGACY_PREFIX_TO_CODE (CAM1=FRONT, CAM2=BACK, CAM3=OUTSIDE_FRONT_GARAGE, CAM4=OUTSIDE_FRONT_POWER, CAM5=OUTSIDE_FRONT_SOLAR, CAM6=OUTSIDE_BACK_SOLAR). Lookup sites in listener.motion_gate_pipeline.is_gate_enabled()/load_thresholds() and infra.gate_cooldown.get_gate_cooldown_seconds() translate the friendly name from the webhook payload via infra.cameras.code_for() before fetching the camera's config blob. The full friendly-name → CAM{N} mapping lives in infra.cameras._LEGACY_PREFIX_TO_CODE.

Phase.165 §11.86.4 (2026-08-30): animal cooldowns added per-camera. Approved values (Note 2026-08-29): CAM3/CAM4/CAM5/CAM6 = 300s (long driveway/field cameras, low animal traffic so longer cooldown is safe), CAM1 = 180s (front-door, animals sometimes wander near), CAM2 = 60s (indoor workshop, resident cats/dogs frequent — short cooldown so we don't miss return visits). Tunable per-camera after week 1 of production data.

CAM5._comment: CAM5 = OUTSIDE_FRONT_SOLAR. Long driveway, slow approach, headlight flares common. Person threshold lowered because partial-view people are common at the gate.

CAM3._comment: CAM3 = OUTSIDE_FRONT_GARAGE. Closer than CAM5, vehicles usually well-framed. Same headlight-flare risk at night.

CAM6._comment: CAM6 = OUTSIDE_BACK_SOLAR. Back of property, longer detection distance. Slightly stricter person threshold because fewer false person detections at distance.

CAM2._comment: CAM2 = BACK_DOOR_INSIDE. Indoor workshop, person-gatekeeper. Animals (cats) sometimes wander in — animal threshold lower to not suppress real cats/dogs.

_phase_6B_154_defaults_applied: 2026-08-28 — Note: 'apply it to all cameras with the defaults'. vehicle=60s, person=120s, motion=180s, default=120s. Tunable per-camera; restart required for config changes.

CAM1._comment: CAM1 = FRONT_DOOR_OUTSIDE. Close range, person-gatekeeper camera. Person threshold lower (more permissive) because we WANT person detections here. Vehicles rarely show up here.

CAM4._comment: CAM4 = OUTSIDE_FRONT_POWER. §11.80 (2026-08-28) — was missing from this config (never enrolled in §11.77 defaults apply); added now that CAM4 is a person+vehicle gatekeeper camera. person threshold at the global default 0.35; gate_cooldown matches the rest of the fleet (vehicle=60s, person=120s, animal=300s, motion=180s, default=120s) so per-camera person floods cap at 1/min.
